nodes.name: Manual isolated test
nodes.notes: Whole-workflow isolated entry only. Verify separate test destinations before execution.

nodes.name: Poll inactive
nodes.notes: 60-second schedule, inactive until reviewed owner manual adoption.

nodes.name: Read control
nodes.notes: Read singleton workflow interlock; this does not own the runner task slot.

nodes.name: Validate entry
nodes.notes: Validate exactly one well-typed global row. Unknown control state stops.

nodes.name: Already held
nodes.notes: Skip work if another execution holds the guard; never expire or reset it.

nodes.name: Report existing hold

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {status:'skipped_held', control:$input.first().json}}];

nodes.notes: Report diagnostic hold without clearing it.

nodes.name: Prepare acquisition
nodes.notes: Capture execution ID and time for compare-and-set acquisition.

nodes.name: Acquire control
nodes.notes: Acquire idle guard conditionally; requires production workflow concurrency=1.

nodes.name: Check acquire receipt
nodes.notes: Verify typed acquisition response before external work.

nodes.name: Read acquired control
nodes.notes: Read persisted singleton rather than trusting write acknowledgement alone.

nodes.name: Verify acquisition
nodes.notes: Require exact guard ownership before calls or mutations.

nodes.name: Require acknowledged completion
nodes.notes: Only acknowledged submission/collection or no-work can release workflow guard.

nodes.name: Read before release
nodes.notes: Read singleton again to prevent releasing another execution.

nodes.name: Verify release ownership
nodes.notes: Check execution, time and completed issue context before clearing busy.

nodes.name: Release control
nodes.notes: Clear workflow busy only. Runner slot release requires separate stopped/publication proof.

nodes.name: Check release receipt
nodes.notes: Require busy=false with unchanged diagnostic ownership.

nodes.name: Read released control
nodes.notes: Read persistence to confirm guard release.

nodes.name: Confirm idle
nodes.notes: Fail closed if persisted idle state differs from acknowledgement.

nodes.name: Report completion

parameters.jsCode: return [{json: {status:'released', outcome:$('Require acknowledged completion').first().json.outcome, control:$input.first().json}}];

nodes.notes: Report bounded orchestration completion, never infer agent completion from guard release.

nodes.name: No work
nodes.notes: Release only this execution guard; durable runner reservation remains unchanged.

nodes.name: Read runner slot
nodes.notes: Read durable singleton and holds. Empty slot permits no-work; unresolved execution is never inferred stopped.

nodes.name: Validate slot
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Have reservation
nodes.notes: No reservation releases only this workflow guard. Otherwise poll same immutable attempt.

nodes.name: Read attempt
nodes.notes: Authenticated stable result read; result consumption never happens implicitly. API observes stopped unit evidence separately.

nodes.name: Validate attempt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Set issue context
nodes.notes: Set selected issue diagnostic only while this execution owns the workflow guard.

nodes.name: Check issue context
nodes.notes: Read update receipt and verify exact execution/issue ownership before writes.

nodes.name: Read result issue
nodes.notes: Observe closure before any publication. Stale Approved/newer state cannot be overwritten by old results.

nodes.name: Read result comments
nodes.notes: Read complete v2 attempt/result markers. Edited, missing or competing marker identity holds.

nodes.name: Read result pulls
nodes.notes: Reconcile every same-branch PR by exact attempt marker, SHA, head, base and actor before any create request.

nodes.name: Plan collection
nodes.notes: Publish stopped done or question outcomes; stopped failures publish with exact marker and Stuck readback. No process proof means no publication.

nodes.name: Issue closed
nodes.notes: Closure records cancellation before further effects. Active cancellation stops the named unit; slot release requires stopped/effect reconciliation.

nodes.name: Record closure cancellation
nodes.notes: Persist cancellation; no PR/state publication after observed closure. Cancellation acknowledgement alone never releases the slot.

nodes.name: Validate cancellation
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Complete read only
nodes.notes: Release short workflow guard while running/non-done/cancelled work retains its durable task reservation.

nodes.name: Done ready
nodes.notes: Only a stopped done result proceeds; active and safe-hold outcomes preserve slot between polls.

nodes.name: Journal PR
nodes.notes: Persist intent before write or confirm exact readback. An unknown/conflicting effect cannot be forgotten or blindly repeated.

nodes.name: Journal PR receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Need PR create
nodes.notes: Existing exact PR is reconciled instead of created again. Missing PR with a prior pending journal holds.

nodes.name: Recheck issue before PR
nodes.notes: Re-read closure, authorship and sole Building immediately before creating the review PR.

nodes.name: Allow PR publication
nodes.notes: Observed closure or changed state suppresses publication; already-issued effects must later be reconciled.

nodes.name: Create review PR
nodes.notes: One POST after committed intent. No automatic retries; lost acknowledgement is an unknown effect requiring exact remote reconciliation.

nodes.name: Check PR receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Read published pulls
nodes.notes: Read all PRs after create or replay; one exact PR must exist and every same-branch conflict holds.

nodes.name: Verify published PR
nodes.notes: Require exact body/actor/head/base/pushed SHA; never treat a different branch result as completion.

nodes.name: Confirm PR
nodes.notes: Persist intent before write or confirm exact readback. An unknown/conflicting effect cannot be forgotten or blindly repeated.

nodes.name: Confirm PR receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Plan result marker
nodes.notes: Match trusted current result metadata and exact body. Owner-owned factory comments are protocol, never human approval.

nodes.name: Journal result marker
nodes.notes: Persist intent before write or confirm exact readback. An unknown/conflicting effect cannot be forgotten or blindly repeated.

nodes.name: Journal result marker receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Need result marker
nodes.notes: Reconcile an existing exact comment instead of posting a duplicate. Unknown prior write holds.

nodes.name: Recheck issue before marker
nodes.notes: Observe closure again before a new comment write. No publication after observed cancellation.

nodes.name: Allow marker publication
nodes.notes: Require same live task state immediately before comment mutation.

nodes.name: Post result marker
nodes.notes: Post one result association marker. Uncertain response retains guard and slot for owner reconciliation.

nodes.name: Check result marker receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Read published comments
nodes.notes: Read back exact unedited result comment before confirming journal or changing labels.

nodes.name: Verify result comment
nodes.notes: Require one actor/content/identity match; missing or edited comment holds.

nodes.name: Confirm result marker
nodes.notes: Persist intent before write or confirm exact readback. An unknown/conflicting effect cannot be forgotten or blindly repeated.

nodes.name: Confirm result marker receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Journal QA state
nodes.notes: Persist intent before write or confirm exact readback. An unknown/conflicting effect cannot be forgotten or blindly repeated.

nodes.name: Journal QA state receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Read before QA
nodes.notes: Fresh closure/current-state read before label transition; stale newer Approved cannot be overwritten.

nodes.name: Validate QA transition
nodes.notes: Only current Building can transition. Already-QA proceeds to readback without repeating writes.

nodes.name: Need QA labels
nodes.notes: Skip label writes when exact target state already persists. This does not skip release proof.

nodes.name: Add Your QA
nodes.notes: Add target label first, preserve unrelated labels, no retry on unknown response.

nodes.name: Check QA addition
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Remove Building
nodes.notes: Remove only Building after QA addition acknowledgement. A partial transition holds.

nodes.name: Check Building removal
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Final result issue
nodes.notes: Read back sole QA and open owner issue before confirming state or releasing reservation.

nodes.name: Final result pulls
nodes.notes: Revalidate exact pushed SHA and PR association after label writes; changed head holds.

nodes.name: Verify QA publication
nodes.notes: Require complete final state and unchanged exact PR, not just successful mutation receipts.

nodes.name: Confirm QA state
nodes.notes: Persist intent before write or confirm exact readback. An unknown/conflicting effect cannot be forgotten or blindly repeated.

nodes.name: Confirm QA state receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Release task reservation
nodes.notes: Runner compares generation, trusted stopped proof, confirmed push/PR/comment/state and unresolved effects before releasing. Workflow guard cannot bypass this predicate.

nodes.name: Validate task release
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Complete collection
nodes.notes: Only confirmed task release completes successful collection. Historical immutable result remains readable.

nodes.name: Question ready
nodes.notes: A stopped structured question follows its own journal/publication/Waiting release path. Other non-done outcomes keep the slot.

nodes.name: Journal question

nodes.name: Journal question receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Need question post
nodes.notes: Existing exact question marker is reconciled rather than posted again; uncertain absent writes hold.

nodes.name: Read before question

nodes.name: Allow question post
nodes.notes: No question publication after observed closure or renewed approval.

nodes.name: Post owner question
nodes.notes: Post trusted question id, exact decision context and explicit owner answer grammar. No blind POST retries.

nodes.name: Check question post
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Read question comments
nodes.notes: Read back exact unedited question, actor, attempt and specification digest. Edited/deleted/conflicting markers hold.

nodes.name: Verify question comment
nodes.notes: One exact current question must persist before state changes or slot release.

nodes.name: Confirm owner question

nodes.name: Confirm owner question receipt

nodes.name: Read before Waiting

nodes.name: Validate Waiting transition
nodes.notes: Only current Building can transition. Already Waiting goes straight to proof readback.

nodes.name: Need Waiting labels

nodes.name: Add Waiting
nodes.notes: Add Waiting first without replacing unrelated labels. Unknown response holds both reservations.

nodes.name: Check Waiting addition
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Remove question Building
nodes.notes: Remove only Building after acknowledged Waiting addition. Partial transition holds for owner recovery.

nodes.name: Check question Building removal
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Final question issue

nodes.name: Final question comments

nodes.name: Verify Waiting publication
nodes.notes: Release requires both exact question marker and complete target-state readback; label alone does not prove stopped.

nodes.name: Confirm Waiting
nodes.notes: Persist intent before write or confirm exact readback. An unknown/conflicting effect cannot be forgotten or blindly repeated.

nodes.name: Confirm Waiting receipt
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Release Waiting reservation
nodes.notes: Compare generation and trusted stopped invocation, confirmed question/state and all effects. Partial work remains available while another task builds.

nodes.name: Validate Waiting release
nodes.notes: Require expected acknowledgement; timeout/unknown response holds without blind retries.

nodes.name: Complete question collection
nodes.notes: A safely released question permits other tasks; an owner answer creates a distinct authorization later.

nodes.name: Failure ready
nodes.notes: Only a stopped current failure can publish Stuck. Active or uncertain work retains the slot.

nodes.name: Journal failure

nodes.name: Journal failure receipt

parameters.content:
## 1. Acquire workflow guard

Shared fail-stop short interlock; no automatic expiry or error-release.

## 2. Read durable task state

Authenticated runner reads and complete GitHub history; unknown target or evidence stops.

## 3. Journal and apply effects

Intent before write; no blind POST replay. Exact marker/head/base and source readback.

## 4. Confirm and release

Reserve only acknowledges submission; collect releases durable slot only with stopped/publication proof. Owner reviews and manually imports matching artifacts.
